AD/Gifted ✨CeraVe AM Facial Moisturising Lotion SPF50✨ I received this product from Cerave Community for review purposes. Thank you @CeraVe_UK for this amazing opportunity. CeraVe AM Facial Moisturising Lotion SPF50 is a hydrating, moisturising lotion that protects skin barrier from water loss and dryness and restore the skin barrier while protecting against skin aggressors like UV rags. It is non-comedogenic, fragrance free and suitable for all skin types  This lotion comes in a nice and sleek 52ml tube packaging along with pump mechanism which is so easy to use and control the amount required and perfect for travelling as well. The texture of this lotion is super lightweight and creamy that is so easy to apply and absorbs quickly into the skin. It doesn’t feel heavy or sticky or doesn’t leave a white caste which is great especially under makeup. Additionally, It is fragrance free, non comedogenic and a non-irritating formula that also provides a soothing effect on the skin. I applied it every morning after cleansing and serum and it instantly hydrates my skin and makes it smooth and silky. I like the fact that it is formulated with great ingredients like 3 essential ceramides, Niacinamide, and vitamin E which works together to moisturise and hydrate up to 24 hours and provides broad spectrum UV protection. I love the fact that it is so easy to apply, absorbs quickly into my skin and also provides a soothing effect. My skin gets really dry sometimes and this lotion does the job perfectly by providing instant relief from dryness and keeps my skin protected from environmental damage, super hydrated and nourished. And I’d highly recommend it. #cerave #MeAndCeraVe #ceravefacialmoisturizinglotion #ceravespf50 #CeraVeHigh
